description: This file contains extension methods for configuring dependency injection services in an ASP.NET Core application, specifically for setting up MediatR, validation, authentication (JWT), logging, and related services.

classes.name: ServicesExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to configure services for dependency injection, JWT authentication, and logging in an ASP.NET Core application.

methods.name: AddConduit
methods.description: Registers application services, MediatR handlers, validators, and utility services like password hashing, JWT token generation, and user context accessor.

methods.name: AddJwt
methods.description: Configures JWT bearer authentication scheme, including setting up token validation parameters and event handlers for message processing.

methods.name: AddSerilogLogging
methods.description: Sets up Serilog logging with console sink and attaches it to the ILoggerFactory.
